body: `initialize` raises an ArgumentError using `#{data.class}`, but `data` is not defined in this scope (will raise `NameError` when `dst_link` is not a String). Also, the `nil` check happens after the type check, so `dst_link=nil` won't hit the intended "Missing documentation link" error. Use `dst_link.class` in the message and check `dst_link.nil?` before the type check (or otherwise structure the validation so both cases produce the intended errors).
